title: Jillstuart Clear Cleansing Balm
full_name: Jill Stuart Jillstuart Clear Cleansing Balm
description_raw:

It leaves your skin smooth and silky smooth with a clear and transparent complexion.
What it does:​●When force is applied to the balm, it melts smoothly like nectar, and its texture changes to oil with a pleasant softness that loosens. The balm spreads smoothly and lightly, without any burden to the skin.
●Contains peony flower extract from the pure white large-flowered “peony” variety called “Snow White​". It helps to achieve a highly translucent skin without dullness.
●Moisturizing extracts from flowers such as Madonna Lily extract and Chamomilla extract, as well as hyaluronic hydrators, are added to fill the skin with moisture and keep it healthy and toned.
●JILL STUART's first cleansing balm is a luxurious blend of botanical oils. The perfect balance of botanical oils, which are highly emollient and provide smooth and supple cleansing, and oils with high cleansing power has been blended to achieve both a moisturizing and makeup-removing effect. ●Contains 88% of beauty essence. The balm, rich in the blessings of flowers, cleanses the skin, leaving it supple as if it has been toned with beauty essence. It cleanses away not only makeup and dirt, but also dead skin cells and pores that inhibit transparency, and leads to supple, smooth skin with a clear, translucent complexion.
●No double cleansing is required. For those who prefer a refreshing wash, a facial cleanser can be used.
What else you need to know:●Alcohol (ethyl alcohol)-free, paraben-free. 
●Clear white floral fragrance.Disclaimer+ View Full Description

A fragrance-free makeup remover balm developed with great ingredients.

This Cleansing balm is clinically proven to be suitable for all skin types and contains no ingredients of animal origin.

What it does:A Brightening Dual Exfoliator to exfoliate and smooth your skin
SEPHORA COLLECTION’s unscented Brightening Dual Exfoliator contains 97% ingredients from natural origin. It has a dual exfoliating action: chemical exfoliation with enzymes from natural origin, and mechanical exfoliation with fine grains of bamboo stems. It removes dead skin and impurities, leaving the skin softer, smoother and more luminous. The complexion is even and imperfections are less visible.

A Brightening Dual Exfoliator with super ingredients to deliver both chemical and mechanical exfoliation
SEPHORA COLLECTION’s Brightening Dual Exfoliator contains 2 star ingredients, which both boast exfoliating properties:
Enzymes from natural origin, extracted from pomegranate, known for their skin exfoliating properties.
Bamboo stem powder from natural origin, also known for its exfoliating properties.
What else you need to know:A Brightening Dual Exfoliator that follows a strict formulation charter
Our double radiance exfoliator contains 97% ingredients from natural origin and is clinically proven to suit all skin types; it does not contain any ingredient from animal origin. We chose to concentrate on effectiveness and star ingredients, which is why our exfoliator is unscented.

title: Salicylic Acid 2% Masque
full_name: The Ordinary Salicylic Acid 2% Masque
description_raw:
DescriptionFunction: FaceSkin Type: Combination, Dry, Normal, Oily, SensitiveSkin Concerns: Breakouts / Blemishes, PoresSkincare By Age: 20s, 30s, 40s, 50+, Under 20What it is:A mask formulated to target lacklustre tone and textural irregularities, with 2% Salicylic Acid, Vegetable Charcoal, Amazonian Clays and Squalane.
What it does:This formula, infused with charcoal and clays, aims to enhance the appearance of smoothness and clarity, leaving the skin feeling refreshed. The structure of salicylic acid facilitates its lipophilicity and miscibility with the lipids located on the surface of the skin. It is a suitable ingredient for targeting the removal of dead skin cells on the surface of oily and blemish-prone skin, with the purpose of revealing more radiant skin beneath. Charcoal and clays are ingredients renowned for their deep cleansing abilities due to their porosity and large surface area available for adsorption. They aid the removal of facial impurities that would otherwise remain on the skin surface and clog pores. In comparison to Salicylic Acid 2% Solution, Salicylic Acid 2% Masque is a rinse-off formula. Leave on for no longer than 10 minutes in order to maximise the exfoliating benefits.
What else you need to know:針對：膚質不均／膚色黯淡 
質地：沖洗面膜Disclaimer+ View Full Description

* Skin Renewal & Brightener: Vegan Powered to gently exfoliate and brighten skin. 
Lemon Peel Oil: Brightens skin and provides re-energizing scent 
Papaya Extract: Rich in papain, an enzyme that chemically exfoliates to remove dead skin cells 
Apple & Pomegranate Fruit Extracts: Powerful antioxidants and contains natural malic acid (AHA) as a gentle skin exfoliant that cleans and brightens skin 
Ascorbyl Tetraisopalmitate: Extremely stable oil-soluble Vitamin C that reduces the appearance of hyperpigmentation, and brightens skin 
Niacinamide: Minimizes the appearance of large pores, improves the look of uneven skin tone, softens the appearance of fine lines, and brightens dull skin 

* Deep Pore Cleanser: Natural AHA’s detoxifies and deep cleanses pores. 
Pyrus Malus (Apple) Peel Extract: Helps cleanse dirt and oils from pores and exfoliates skin 

* Skin Softener: 
Hyaluronic Acid: softens and moisturizes skin 
Vegan derived Cellulose Peel: Gently exfoliates skin to allow moisturizers to deeply hydrate the skin 

* Clean & Free From: 
Sulfates, phthalates, gluten, parabens and synthetic fragrances 
Cruelty-free 
Vegan 

* What else you need to know: 
Clarifying chemical exfoliant 
Enzymatic peeling action of papain 
Renewal action of apple & pommegranate extracts 
Allergy Alert: Contains aromatherapy from natural essential oils for holistic well being. Citrus Peel Oils such as Limonene and Linalool may cause photosensitive reactions. Rinse well after use. 

* Skin Renewal is our body’s natural biological process of creating new healthy skin to replace existing damaged skin, via exfoliation. Nudeskin’s science is based on Skin Renewal Optimization (SRO). Skin Renewal Optimization (SRO) works through daily topical dosing of the dermatologist-recommended actives in the Nudeskin’s Four-Step Ritual to get visibly softer, clearer, smoother, and brighter skin.  

* Clinical Results: In a consumer panel: 
100% of the consumers agreed that Lemon-Aid Detox & Glow Peel made their skin feel soft after use 
100% of the consumers agreed that Lemon-Aid Detox & Glow Peel made their skin deeply clean after use 
86% of the consumers agreed that Lemon-Aid Detox & Glow Peel made their skin look less congested after use

description_raw:
DescriptionSkin Type: Combination, Dry, Normal, Oily, SensitiveSkin Concerns: Dryness, Dullness, Uneven Skin TextureFormulation: LiquidSkincare By Age: 20s, 30s, 40s, 50+, Under 20What it is:A gentle exfoliating toner that promotes smoother, brighter skin while boosting hydration. Suitable for sensitive skin.
What it does:Saccharomyces Ferment 30% Milky Toner gently exfoliates for smoother, more hydrated and radiant skin. Through this gentle exfoliation, it helps to reduce textural irregularities and smooth skin texture, and helps to reduce the look of dark spots, resulting in brighter, more radiant skin. Saccharomyces Ferment 30% Milky Toner has a lightweight texture, and is suitable for all skin types, including sensitive skin. 搖到化妝棉上，掃過面部。早晚潔面後使用。

可以與紅茶酵素抗氧精華水合併使用嗎？
絕對可以。爽膚在日常護理中，能助你做二次清潔，建議潔面後使用這款爽膚水，收細毛孔並去除多餘雜質。 紅茶酵素抗氧精華水會是下一步，因爲它是護理肌膚的第一步。

此配方含有透明質酸嗎？
有。透明質酸有助增加肌膚水分，使肌膚不論外觀或感覺都特別柔軟。

含有酒精嗎？
不含酒精配方，適合所有皮膚。Disclaimer+ View Full Description

title: Lotus Youth Preserve Dream Toner
full_name: FRESH Lotus Youth Preserve Dream Toner
description_raw:
DescriptionWhat it is:A gentle exfoliating treatment toner that reveals a brighter, more radiant complexion, allowing you to feel truly confident in your skin.
What it does:A gentle exfoliating treatment toner that reveals a brighter, more radiant complexion, allowing you to feel truly confident in your skin.  Powered by rainbow algae extract, this treatment is clinically proven to visibly fade dark spots, tighten pores, and smooth skin texture, while respecting skin’s natural tone. 
Infused with Super Lotus, succinic & glycolic acids, the effervescent liquid formula absorbs quickly with a comforting peach scent.  PROVEN RESULTS  99% of ultra-premium serum users saw visibly rejuvenated skin* 96% saw diminished signs of age & time on their face & eye area*  
*clinical assessment by dermatologist, 32 subjects, comparing results from the morning after night 10 to after 4 weeks
What it includes:彩虹藻萃取物 
有效顯著減淡肌膚表面色斑，重現原生肌膚與生俱來的明亮、均勻膚色。採取自法國布列塔尼海岸，乳白色的彩虹藻於暗黑深海中折射明亮光線－猶如彩虹藻萃取物提亮肌膚瑕疵的過程。

超級睡蓮
通過撫平細紋及粗糙膚質，阻截肌膚衰老的第一道痕跡。有效提升肌膚光澤，並保護肌膚免受環境污染物侵害。超級睡蓮採集自阿拉巴馬州的Ten Mile Creek農場並通過「道德採購」1認證。這款創新的植物萃取蘊含整棵睡蓮的活性成分，有助令肌膚保持年輕。

琥珀酸
可顯著暢通堵塞毛孔、緊緻毛孔並減少多餘油光。琥珀酸具有水楊酸2的同等功效，有效溫和不刺激地減少肌膚表面瑕疵，同時紓緩及鎮靜肌膚。

乙醇酸
是一款「α-羥基酸」(AHA)，有助去除老廢角質重現平滑膚質，達至煥膚亮肌效果。其微細分子可滲透肌膚底層，幫助分解死皮細胞。What else you need to know:* Learn more about Sephora’s Clean initiatives here, including the list of “formulated without” ingredients and what makes a brand Clean, Planet Aware or Clean + Planet Aware.Disclaimer+ View Full Description

title: Natural Moisturizing Factors + HA
full_name: The Ordinary Natural Moisturizing Factors + HA
description_raw:
DescriptionSkin Type: Combination, Dry, Normal, OilySkin Concerns: DrynessFormulation: CreamSkincare By Age: 20s, 30s, 40s, 50+, Under 20What it is:Surface Hydration Formula
What it does:

Natural Moisturizing Factors (NMF) are elements that keep the outer layer of the skin protected and well-hydrated. NMF are made up of multiple amino acids, fatty acids, triglycerides, urea, ceramides, phospholipids, glycerin, saccharides, sodium PCA, hyaluronic acid and many other compounds that are naturally present in the skin. 


This formula offers non-greasy hydration that acts as a direct topical supplement of impaired NMF components. It contains 11 amino acids, phospholipids, alpha/beta/gamma fatty acids, triglycerides, sterols and sterol esters, glycerin, ceramide precursors, urea, saccharides, sodium PCA and hyaluronic acid. It offers immediate hydration and lasting results with continued use.

title: Argan Oil
full_name: Melvita Argan Oil
description_raw:
DescriptionSkin Type: Combination, Dry, Normal, Oily, SensitiveSkin Concerns: Dryness, Fine Lines & Wrinkles, Firmness & ElasticityHair Type: Coloured, Curly / Permed, Dry, Normal, OilyHair Concerns: Dryness, FrizzFinish: Smooth & GlossyFormulation: OilSkincare By Age: 20s, 30s, 40s, 50+, Under 20What it is:Sourced from argan harvested on the Moroccan coast, the organic argan oil is rich in fatty acids (Omega-6 and Omega-9) and plant sterols, providing nourishing, moisturizing and protective effects for dry and sensitive skin, achieving long-lasting hydration. Omega-6 can repair and restore the moisturizing layer, making the cells tightly packed and locking in moisture, while Omega-9 can strengthen and consolidate the lipid barrier, reducing water loss. Using the "2-step locked-in hydration technology", the moisture of the hydrating products is locked in layer by layer for comprehensive long-lasting hydration. 100% organic ingredients, no mineral oil, closely matched to the skin and non-comedogenic.
What it does:The secret to hydration: first replenish water, then replenish oil. Skin is about 70% water, and the key to skin hydration is the lipid layer. The lipid layer directly affects skin moisture, elasticity and firmness. The lipid layer composed of oil has three main functions:  · Locks in water molecules, preventing water loss from the skin's surface  · Prevents the loss of the skin's natural moisturizing factors  · Protects the skin from external damage  Replenishing natural oils and repairing the lipid barrier restores the perfect water-oil balance, becoming the primary key to hydration.
What else you need to know:100% natural-origin & 99.9% certified organic ingredients. 
COSMEBIO certified.
Suitable for all skin type, especially dry and fragile.

Melvita argan oil is certified as fairly traded under the Fair For Life standard*. It is produced in Morocco without the use of chemical solvents and is strictly controlled to guarantee outstanding quality.
*Available at www.fairforlife.org

title: C.E.O. Vitamin C Rich Hydration Cream
full_name: SUNDAY RILEY C.E.O. Vitamin C Rich Hydration Cream
description_raw:
DescriptionSkin Type: Combination, Dry, Normal, Oily, SensitiveSkin Concerns: Ageing, Dryness, Dullness, Pigmentation & Dark Spots, Uneven Skin TextureFormulation: CreamSkincare By Age: 20s, 30s, 40s, 50+, Under 20What it is:A hydrating moisturizer that infuses skin with high-potency, advanced vitamin C (THD ascorbate) to fight the first visible signs of aging while providing powerful antioxidant support.
What it does:C.E.O. C + E Protect and Repair Moisturizer infuses five percent advanced, oxygen-stable tetrahexydecyl ascorbate (THD ascorbate) into the skin—the gold standard form of vitamin C. THD ascorbate is the newer, clinically-proven, oil-soluble derivative of vitamin C, which penetrates better into the skin while being exceptionally stable against oxygenation. With 5 percent THD ascorbate, this moisturizer is powerful at fighting the first visible signs of aging and restoring vital skin radiance, while being uniquely suitable for those with sensitive skin, as THD ascorbate is significantly less irritating than other forms of vitamin C. Once in the skin, it helps boost youthful-looking skin texture and volume, in addition to providing photostable, antioxidant support.   Blended with protective, anti-pollution expopolysaccharides and refining lime pearl extract, this formula visibly repairs the effects of aging, environmental stress, and pollution-induced damage. It is rich yet never greasy, providing hydration and antioxidant protection to the skin for a visibly younger, softer, and healthier-looking complexion.
What else you need to know:THD ascorbate (tetrahexyldecyl ascorbate) is the superior form of vitamin C. It is more stable and less irritating than ascorbic acid and other vitamin C derivatives.Disclaimer+ View Full Description

ingredients_raw: Marula Butter: This super-pure, concentrated butter is derived from marula oil and rich in antioxidant polyphenols, lipids, and a comprehensive mix of fatty acids (omegas 3, 6 and 9), making it an intensely nourishing ingredient for skin. Meadowfoam Oil: With its uniquely high concentration of fatty acids—more so than most plant oils— meadowfoam is an especially nourishing moisturizer and skin-soother. Cupuaçu Butter: Extracted from the seeds of the cupuaçu fruit, this plant butter is used for its ultra-rich moisturizing properties, skin-soothing phytosterols, and antioxidant polyphenols. Shea Butter: A concentrated butter, derived from the shea fruit, with a complex triglyceride composition that is responsible for its characteristic rich, emollient properties. It contains high amounts of oleic acid and can enhance the penetration of other ingredients. Cucurbita Pepo (Pumpkin) Seed Oil: Contains high amounts of omega fatty acids and is a rich source of antioxidant carotenoids (responsible for the orange pigment in fruits and vegetables) and beta-carotene. Green Tea Seed Oil: Moisturizing, fatty-acid-rich oil derived from the seeds of the green tea plant. Like all forms of green tea, it contains powerful antioxidant xanthines (like caffeine) and polyphenols (such as epigallocatechin gallate, epigallocatechin, and epicatechins) that play a critical role in defending skin against environmental—particularly UV-generated—free radical damage. Rose Hip Fruit Oil: Aka rosehip seed oil. Lightweight, moisturizing oil extracted from the seeds of the rose hip fruit and used for its high fatty acid content (mainly linoleic acid, followed by linolenic and oleic). The SEPHORA COLLECTION Firming Day Cream improves firmness, elasticity and the appearance of wrinkles and fine lines thanks to its duo of ingredients from natural origin with recognized powers:
Squalane from natural origin, sourced from olive, known to hydrate and firm skin.

An hydrating and firming day cream for all skin types
Our fiming day cream is formulated with 97% ingredients from natural origin. It is clinically proven for all skin types, including sensitive ones, and does not contain any ingredient from animal origin. We chose to focus on effectiveness and star ingredients, which is why the formula is unscented.

Unscented and made with 93% ingredients from natural origin, the Sephora Collection Overnight Hydrating Mask is your new ally for skin that’s refreshed, smoothed and hydrated for up to 24h*.

Strict formulation charter: 
Our moisturizing mask contains 93% ingredients from natural origin and is clinically proven to suit all types of skin. On top of that, it doesn’t contain any animal-derived ingredients. We chose to concentrate on effectiveness and star ingredients, which is why our mask is unscented. 


Measured scientifically on 33 volunteers, 24 hours after application

Signs of fatigue improved by 44%(2)

Allies of Skin‘s Supercharged Night Cream is available in 2 progressive strengths, formulated to hydrate, brighten, and reduce multiple signs of aging. This Advanced 0.1% concentration includes patented Encapsulated Retinaldehyde, 6 Peptides, 2% Ornithine and EGCG Complex, 11 Brighteners and Antioxidants, and an 8.7% Ceramide and Omegas Complex. Ideal for experienced Retinal users, or users of the 0.05% concentration, looking to enhance their results.  Retinal is 30% gentler¹ and 3X more bio-active than retinol². The Night Cream targets the appearance of fine lines, wrinkles, blemishes and pigmentation for skin that looks younger, feels firmer, and is visibly smoother – with no morning-after redness.  All skin types, especially dull, dehydrated skin or skin showing signs of premature aging.
What it does:DISCOVER THE RETINAL DIFFERENCE  
Retinal is 30% gentler than Retinol.¹
Retinal is 3x more bio-active than Retinol.²
Retinal is 11x faster-acting than Retinol.³
Retinol needs 10x the concentration of Retinal to maintain collagen levels.⁴
IN 1 USE: 
27% more radiant skin immediately after the first application.⁸ 
Instant improvement on sagging skin.⁹ 
IN 8 DAYS: 
1.3x faster skin renewal.⁵ 
27% accelerated cellular activity.⁵ 
IN 1 MONTH: 
Up to 75% more radiant skin.¹⁴ 
44% more radiant skin.¹² 
92% experience more radiant skin.¹² 
Promotes smoother + firmer-looking skin.¹¹ 
Helps improve skin elasticity.¹¹ 
84% see smoother skin.¹² 
IN 2 MONTHS: 
11% less sagginess of the upper cheeks.¹⁷ 
Clinically proven to reduce redness.¹⁸ 
14% improved elasticity for plumper-looking skin.¹⁸ 
16% firmer skin.¹⁸

The most bio-available, potent, and fastest-acting cosmetic Retinoid, to help improve the look of wrinkles, fine lines, photo damage, and uneven skin tone while being well-tolerated by the skin. 

6 PEPTIDES  
A powerful blend of Peptides that helps reduce the appearance of wrinkles and fine lines for smoother and firmer looking skin.  

2% ORNITHINE & EGCG COMPLEX  
An innovative combination of Amino Acids and antioxidants with firming, soothing, and calming properties. Reduces the appearance of structural aging and plumps the skin. 

8.7% CERAMIDE & OMEGAS COMPLEX

What it does:HAND MASKS

Texture: Mask
Skin type: Normal, dry and mixed
Benefits:
Nourishing and comforting hand mask with wild mango extract and moisturizing and smoothing hand mask with aloe vera extract.

Effortlessly pamper your hands in a fun way with these treatment gloves. With their gel formula, the hand masks work in just 15 minutes, to make your hands softer, more nourished and moisturized. Tactile gloves that are easy to use, and you can even use your phone with them, while taking care of your hands.

TREATMENT WITH INGREDIENTS FROM NATURAL ORIGIN 
The SEPHORA COLLECTION hand mask is a targeted response to everyday concerns. Enriched with plant and fruit extracts and formulated with 95% ingredients from natural origin. It is available in two formulas.

A HAND MASK TO NOURISH AND MOISTURIZE
Nourishing and comforting or moisturizing and smoothing – you choose: our hand masks give your hands immediate hydration and comfort, including dry hands.

Super ingredients carefully selected to meet your hands’ needs:
Nourishing and comforting hand mask with wild mango extract: Mango butter is obtained from the fruit kernel. It is rich in fatty acids to nourish and repair dry skin. The mango hand mask has a new design. 
Moisturizing and smoothing hand mask with aloe vera: This plant is known for its moisturizing and soothing qualities – it’s the ideal ingredient to moisturize dry hands. 

These products are vegan.*
*Free from animal-derived ingredients.

Test results: 
Hand mask with wild mango extract:
+80%(1) more hydration after 30 minutes. 100 %(2) of people found their hands were nourished after the first use. 95 %(2) of people found the masks give a feeling of comfort from the first use.

Hand mask with aloe vera extract:
+81 %(3) more hydration, 30 minutes after application. 100 %(2) of people found their hands were softer after the first use. 100 %(2) of people found their hands’ feeling of dryness was soothed from the first use.

(1) Scientific measurement performed on 11 people, 30 minutes after application.
(2) % of people satisfied after the first application. Satisfaction survey with 22 people.
(3) Scientific measurement performed on 32 people, 30 minutes after application.

What else you need to know:The gel texture of Sephora Collection’s hand masks acts quickly to repair skin in just fifteen minutes, leaving hands soft, nourished, and hydrated. In addition to being waterproof, which means you can remain active while you are wearing them, our hand mask gloves are decorated with the colors of their ingredients. They feel so good, you won’t want to take them off!

description_raw:
DescriptionFunction: FaceSkin Type: Combination, Dry, Normal, Oily, SensitiveSkin Concerns: Dullness, Fine Lines & Wrinkles, Uneven Skin Texture, Uneven Skin Tone, PoresSkincare By Age: 20s, 30s, 40s, 50+, Under 20What it is:Babyfacial™ is a pro-quality AHA/BHA “facial” that resurfaces to reveal greater clarity, improved skin texture and tone, and a more youthful radiance. Think of it as an extra nudge for stubborn, dull skin (in other words, it’ll knock your cells off).
What it does:This next-generation mask is an at-home “facial” that effectively yet gently exfoliates the pore lining and resurfaces by getting rid of built-up dead skin cells. With a whopping 25% AHA / 2% BHA blend of our dream team glycolic, tartaric, lactic, citric and salicylic acids, this pro-quality formula dramatically smooths texture while minimizing the look of pores, fine lines and wrinkles. Uniquely formulated with chickpea flour, pumpkin ferment and a soothing antioxidant blend of matchatea, milk thistle and apple, Babyfacial™ delivers incredible brightening and enzymatic action, improves skin’s elastic feel and reveals the look of a more even, radiant baby-soft complexion.
What else you need to know:Babyfacial™ was created with all skin in mind. Glycolic acids get a bad rap for being sensitizing, but we believe that it’s the pH level and accompanying ingredients (think fragrant oils or high amounts of alcohol) that can be the real problem. We formulated Babyfacial™ at the ideal pH level of 3.5 with a blend of acids that work together synergistically to ensure higher efficacy without the redness and sensitization.  Free of essential oils, silicones and fragrance.  Vegan, gluten-free, cruelty-free.

title: Hyaluronic Acid 2% + B5
full_name: The Ordinary Hyaluronic Acid 2% + B5
description_raw:
DescriptionSkin Type: Combination, Dry, Normal, OilySkin Concerns: Dryness, Fine Lines & Wrinkles, Uneven Skin TextureSkincare By Age: 20s, 30s, 40s, 50+, Under 20What it is:A reformulation of our most-loved hydration serum that instantly hydrates and plumps, while smoothing texture and wrinkles. This new formula has a slight yellow tinge when compared to our previous formula due to the addition of a ceramide blend. This is the natural colour of this new raw material.
What it does:"Hyaluronic Acid 2% + B5 provides instant plumping hydration to give softer, smoother, healthy-looking skin. The lightweight formula replenishes skin’s hydration levels with all-day results, and helps the skin retain moisture to replump dry, dehydrated skin. Hyaluronic Acid 2% + B5 also promotes skin suppleness and elasticity, while minimising the appearance of fine dry lines.  

This formulation contains 5 forms of hyaluronic acid, which helps provide hydration to multiple layers of the surface of skin. Hyaluronic acid is a humectant found naturally in the skin where it binds to water. The forms included are low-, medium- and high-molecular- weight molecules, a HA crosspolymer, and hydrolyzed HA. 

The formulation also contains ceramides to help keep moisture locked in. Ceramides are lipids (fatty molecules) found naturally in the skin that help support the skin barrier to keep skin protected and hydrated. The ceramides used in this formula are known as sphingolipids 

Pro-vitamin B5 helps support the formation of key skin barrier components like ceramides and fatty acids, which further helps keep moisture locked in, keeping the skin moisturized for longer. 

Testing Shows: 
Provides instant plumping hydration that lasts all day 
Gives instantly smoother-feeling skin 
Strengthens the skin’s moisture barrier 
Promotes supple skin with improved elasticity 
Minimizes the look of fine dry lines"

title: AHA 30% + BHA 2% Peeling Solution
full_name: The Ordinary AHA 30% + BHA 2% Peeling Solution
description_raw:
DescriptionSkin Type: Combination, Dry, Normal, Oily, SensitiveSkin Concerns: Dullness, Fine Lines & Wrinkles, Uneven Skin TextureSkincare By Age: 20s, 30s, 40s, 50+, Under 20What it is:10-Minute Exfoliating Facial
What it does:
With 30% Alpha Hydroxyl Acids (Glycolic/Lactic/Tartaric/Citric), 2% Beta Hydroxyl Acid (Salicylic Acid), Hyaluronic Acid Crosspolymer, Vitamin B5, Black Carrot and Tasmanian Pepperberry. Alpha hydroxyl acids (AHA) exfoliate the skin's topmost surface for a brighter and more even appearance. Beta hydroxyl acids (BHA) also exfoliate the skin with an extended function to help clear pore congestion. This combined 32% AHA/BHA solution offers deeper exfoliation to help fight visible blemishes and for improved skin radiance. The formula also improves the appearance of skin texture and reduces the look of fine lines with continued use. This formula contains a studied Tasmanian Pepperberry derivative to help reduce irritation associated with acid use. This derivative is of plant origin and varies in colour seasonally and this colour variation may be apparent in the formula from time to time. This formula is further supported with a crosspolymer form of hyaluronic acid for comfort, Vitamin B5 to assist healing and black carrot as an antioxidant. 
Note: This formula contains a very high concentration of free acids. We recommend use only if you are an experienced user of acid exfoliation and your skin is not sensitive.
Contraindications: This formula should not be used on sensitive, peeling or compromised skin. Please refer to additional sun protection note and other warnings in provided Directions. 
This pH of this formula is approximately 3.6. Glycolic Acid, the primary AHA used in the formula, has a pKa of 3.6 and pKa is the most important aspect to consider in formulating with acids. pKa implies acid availability. When pKa is close to pH, there is an ideal balance between salt and acidity, maximizing effectiveness of the acid and reducing irritation. Higher pH numbers in such a case would increase salt which counter-intuitively would make the formula even more irritating than if the formula was more acidic.

title: Granactive Retinoid 2% Emulsion
full_name: The Ordinary Granactive Retinoid 2% Emulsion
description_raw:
DescriptionSkin Type: Combination, Dry, Normal, OilySkin Concerns: Ageing, Fine Lines & Wrinkles, Uneven Skin Texture, Uneven Skin ToneSkincare By Age: 20s, 30s, 40s, 50+What it is:Previously Advanced Retinoid 2%
What it does:As of late August 2017, The Ordinary's portfolio of retinoids has been extended based on valuable consumer feedback and, as part of these introductions, Advanced Retinoid 2% has been renamed to Granactive Retinoid 2% Emulsion to align with the new naming direction of the extended range. The formula continues to offer an emulsion of 2% of the same advanced retinoid complex. The box and label change for the existing Advanced Retinoid will be in rotation for a few weeks as new packaging finds its way through distribution.
This formulation combines two forms of next-generation retinoid actives: 


A 2% concentration of Granactive Retinoid which is a complex of solubilized Hydroxypinacolone Retinoate (HPR). HPR is a highly-advanced form of retinoid which is, in fact, a non-prescription ester of all-trans direct retinoic acid that offers a multi-fold better effect against signs of aging than retinol, retinyl palmitate and nearly all other forms of non-prescription retinoid; 


A sustained-delivery form of pure retinol in a protective capsule system which supports both the delivery and the effect of Granactive Retinoid. 


Both forms of retinoid used avoid the irritation associated with retinoids (including retinol) use while delivering better visible results against signs of aging.
This product uses next-generation retinoid active technologies which have been shown to achieve better reduction in signs of aging than retinol without irritation. These technologies cannot be compared directly with retinol itself in terms of concentration because they include a different retinoid molecule, in a similar way that Retinol cannot be compared with Retinoic Acid in terms of concentration. If you have interest in a retinol product, please refer to our Retinol portfolio above which products contain pure retinol and cost less since many retinol technologies cost less than their next-generation counterparts like Granactive Retinoid. While the new offerings of Granactive Retinoid in Squalane offer a very-light-weight solution for better compatibility with several steps in a regimen, the existing formula continues to be a creamy hydrating emulsion for those who prefer this format. 
Caution: Retinoids can make the skin more sensitive to UV radiation. Sun protection is particularly important when using retinoids. This product must not be used in conjunction with other retinoids including retinol or retinoic acid. This product is not a treatment for acne. Acne-prone skin may experience a temporary increase in acne during the first few weeks of using any form of retinoid including those used in this formulation.
Note: When pregnant or breastfeeding, it is recommended to avoid any skincare products containing retinoids such as formulations with Granactive Retinoid or Retinol.

However, many forms of Vitamin C and many more formulations of Vitamin C are available commercially with a potential to confuse the audience. We have developed a guide that offers guidance on the formulations of Vitamin C offered under The Ordinary range. It also offers education on Vitamin C itself and on the differences between formulations of Vitamin C at large. Please click here for this guide. 
Note: The format of this formula is a suspension of very fine L-Ascorbic Acid powder and, as such, provides the most direct exposure of extremely high concentrations of Vitamin C topically. With such format, there are 2 important things to consider: 


A very strong tingling but non-irritating sensation is expected during the first 1-2 weeks of use until the skin's tolerance to such high exposure is elevated. If the sensation is too strong to tolerate, the formula can be mixed on each application with other creams or serums of your preference.


The powder exposure to the skin disallows the formula to feel like a serum, lotion or cream and each application requires a few seconds to feel absorbed by the skin. This formula feels gritty for a few seconds after application. If you prefer to avoid this gritty feel, we suggest our Vitamin C Suspension 30% in Silicone. 


Alternative products on the market offer suspensions of Vitamin C in water-free formulations in heavier silicone bases to avoid the "powdery" feel of the suspension. These formulations do keep the Vitamin C stable but they are almost always offered in heavier silicone bases that interfere with efficient exposure of the entire Vitamin C content to the skin (the silicone entraps the Vitamin C). Our formula avoids the use of silicones and offers complete and direct exposure of the entire powder content to the skin, maximizing topical delivery. If you prefer a lighter silicone base instead for a smoother skin feel, we suggest our Vitamin C Suspension 30% in Silicone. 
Note: Based on recommendation from our customers, this formula is now offered in a tube format for easier dispensing.

What it does:This light-textured formula contains an extremely high 5% concentration of caffeine, supplemented with highly-purified Epigallocatechin Gallatyl Glucoside (EGCG) from green tea leaves. Independent studies have shown that topical use of each of caffeine and EGCG can help reduce looks of puffiness and of dark circles in the eye contour. Additional studies have shown that caffeine can also reduce the appearance of cellulite.
Notes:


Hollowness in the eye contour as a result of structure of sub-dermal tissues like fat and bone can result in visible shadows under the eyes. This shadow, which is not to be mistaken for dark circles, cannot be addressed with topical skincare including this formula.


Fat deposits under the eye contour can create permanent puffiness in this area. This type of deposit cannot be improved with topical skincare, including this formula.


Supplied in UV-protective packaging as EGCG is sensitive to light.

title: Hyaluronic Acid 2% + B5
full_name: The Ordinary Hyaluronic Acid 2% + B5
description_raw:
DescriptionSkin Type: Combination, Dry, Normal, OilySkin Concerns: Dryness, Fine Lines & Wrinkles, Uneven Skin TextureSkincare By Age: 20s, 30s, 40s, 50+, Under 20What it is:A reformulation of our most-loved hydration serum that instantly hydrates and plumps, while smoothing texture and wrinkles. This new formula has a slight yellow tinge when compared to our previous formula due to the addition of a ceramide blend. This is the natural colour of this new raw material.
What it does:"Hyaluronic Acid 2% + B5 provides instant plumping hydration to give softer, smoother, healthy-looking skin. The lightweight formula replenishes skin’s hydration levels with all-day results, and helps the skin retain moisture to replump dry, dehydrated skin. Hyaluronic Acid 2% + B5 also promotes skin suppleness and elasticity, while minimising the appearance of fine dry lines.  

This formulation contains 5 forms of hyaluronic acid, which helps provide hydration to multiple layers of the surface of skin. Hyaluronic acid is a humectant found naturally in the skin where it binds to water. The forms included are low-, medium- and high-molecular- weight molecules, a HA crosspolymer, and hydrolyzed HA. 

The formulation also contains ceramides to help keep moisture locked in. Ceramides are lipids (fatty molecules) found naturally in the skin that help support the skin barrier to keep skin protected and hydrated. The ceramides used in this formula are known as sphingolipids 

Pro-vitamin B5 helps support the formation of key skin barrier components like ceramides and fatty acids, which further helps keep moisture locked in, keeping the skin moisturized for longer. 

Testing Shows: 
Provides instant plumping hydration that lasts all day 
Gives instantly smoother-feeling skin 
Strengthens the skin’s moisture barrier 
Promotes supple skin with improved elasticity 
Minimizes the look of fine dry lines"

title: Lactic Acid 10% + HA 2%
full_name: The Ordinary Lactic Acid 10% + HA 2%
description_raw:
DescriptionSkin Type: Combination, Dry, Normal, Oily, SensitiveSkin Concerns: Dryness, Fine Lines & Wrinkles, Uneven Skin TextureSkincare By Age: 20s, 30s, 40s, 50+, Under 20What it is:A High-Strength Lactic Acid Superficial Peeling Formulation
What it does:
Lactic Acid is an alpha hydroxy acid that exfoliates the skin. This 10% formulation offers mild exfoliation and is supported with a purified Tasmanian pepperberry known to reduce signs of inflammation and sensitivity that is often associated with exfoliation. A milder 5% formula is available here. 
This formula contains a studied Tasmanian Pepperberry derivative to help reduce irritation associated with acid use. This derivative is of plant origin and varies in colour seasonally and this colour variation may be apparent in the formula from time to time. 
Contraindications: Lactic Acid should not be used on sensitive, peeling or compromised skin. Please refer to additional sun protection note and other warnings in provided Directions. 
This pH of this formula is approximately 3.8. Lactic Acid has a pKa of 3.8 and pKa is the most important aspect to consider in formulating with acids. pKa implies acid availability. When pKa is close to pH, there is an ideal balance between salt and acidity, maximizing effectiveness of the acid and reducing irritation. Higher pH numbers in such a case would increase salt which counter-intuitively would make the formula even more irritating than if the formula was more acidic. 
Note: While Lactic Acid can result in quick visible benefits, we generally suggest indirect forms of skin exfoliation in favour of direct forms such as this formula due to potential inflammation and sensitivity associated with acids. Please refer to NIOD's Non-Acid Acid Precursor for such a reference.

title: Balancing & Clarifying Serum
full_name: The Ordinary Balancing & Clarifying Serum
description_raw:
DescriptionSkin Type: Combination, Normal, OilySkin Concerns: Breakouts / Blemishes, Ageing, Dryness, Dullness, Oiliness, Uneven Skin Texture, PoresSkincare By Age: 20s, 30s, 40s, 50+, Under 20What it is:A multi-active solution designed to reduce signs of skin congestion by minimizing excess shine, and improving pore appearance for clearer-looking skin.
What it does:Balancing & Clarifying Serum provides visibly clearer skin, by helping to reduce the look of pores, excess oil, and uneven skin texture. The formulation offers a simple way to treat multiple concerns, offering a total of seven key benefits for blemish-prone and congested skin. While especially suited to oily and combination skin, it is tested and suitable for all skin types.
Balancing & Clarifying Serum minimizes excess shine, and helps reduce the look of enlarged pores, which can be common concerns for oily skin types. It also provides all-day hydration and strengthens the skin barrier to help balance skin’s oil and water content, to avoid drying or stripping the skin.
In addition, Balancing & Clarifying Serum helps to improve uneven skin texture for smoother-looking skin, while also reducing visible post-acne marks and promoting skin radiance to make skin look clearer and brighter.
As part of our range of Multi-Active Solutions, Balancing & Clarifying combines seven key technologies to achieve these benefits:
Sarcosine and L-Carnitine:
Naturally occurring molecules that reduce the appearance of oiliness and shine.
Polylysine:
A patented molecule that also reduces the appearance of oiliness and shine. It has a unique three-dimensional branched structure that is composed of 48 naturally-derived lysine amino acids.
Adenosine:
Helps reduce the appearance of pores and textured skin.
N-Acetylglucosamine (NAG):
An amino sugar that offers similar exfoliation properties to direct acids. Through this exfoliation, it helps target signs of congestion, while also targeting the look of uneven skin tone.
Ectoin:
Protects the skin barrier against water loss and helps maintain skin hydration. The ingredient ectoin is an amino acid derivative produced via fermentation from ectoine - a naturally occurring molecule found in a wide range of bacteria that live in extreme conditions.
Lactococcus Ferment Lysate:
Works to help support the skin barrier. It is a mixture of fragmented molecules derived from the breakdown of the bacteria lactococcus lactis.
Testing shows Balancing & Clarifying Serum:
Provides visibly clearer skin by helping reduce signs of congestion including the look of pores, excess oil and uneven skin texture

Minimizes excess shine
Improves skin texture
Reduces the appearance of post-acne marks
Provides all-day hydration
Strengthens the skin barrier
Boosts skin radiance

Sugar-based Hydrators: Boost hydration and support the skin barrier. Centella Asiatica Phytotechnologies: Protect the skin from irritants and promotes skin barrier repair.  **Testing on 34 panellists using the product 2x/day for 6 weeks.

title: Ascorbyl Glucoside Solution 12%
full_name: The Ordinary Ascorbyl Glucoside Solution 12%
description_raw:
DescriptionSkin Type: Combination, Dry, Normal, Oily, SensitiveSkin Concerns: Ageing, Dullness, Pigmentation & Dark Spots, Uneven Skin ToneSkincare By Age: 20s, 30s, 40s, 50+, Under 20What it is:A Brightening Serum with Stabilized Vitamin C Derivative
What it does:Vitamin C is an effective antioxidant, brightens the skin tone and reduces signs of aging. In its pure form, Vitamin C is unstable in water. Ascorbyl Glucoside is a water-soluble derivative of Vitamin C. It is much more stable in water but it is less potent than direct L-Ascorbic Acid. Being more compatible with water allows for a very pleasant serum texture. It is considered a gold standard of Vitamin C derivatives due to its high stability and comfortable use, but it's impossible to achieve extremely high L-Ascorbic Acid potency with this solution. Aside from the general benefits of pure Vitamin C, Ascorbyl Glucoside has been shown to offer specific skin brightening benefits.

title: GF 15% Solution
full_name: The Ordinary GF 15% Solution
description_raw:
DescriptionSkin Type: Combination, Dry, Normal, OilySkin Concerns: Ageing, Dryness, Dullness, Fine Lines & Wrinkles, Firmness & Elasticity, Uneven Skin TextureSkincare By Age: 20s, 30s, 40s, 50+, Under 20What it is:An age-support serum containing a 15% solution of growth factors to help minimize and repair visible skin  damage to regenerate the look of aging skin.
What it does:GF 15% Solution helps minimize and repair visible skin damage to regenerate the appearance of aging skin across the face and neck. This growth factor serum incorporates three technologies to target:  Fine lines and wrinkles: GF 15% Solution helps to regenerate the look of skin by reducing the appearance of fine lines and wrinkles, including crow’s feet, forehead lines, and smile lines. Loss of skin firmness: GF 15% Solution firms the face and neck, and the jawline looks more lifted and defined.  Loss of elasticity: GF 15% Solution helps to promote skin elasticity to reduce the look of lax skin.  Rough Texture: GF 15% Solution helps to retexturize rough skin to make skin look smoother and more even. Dull Skin Tone: GF 15% Solution promotes radiance, leaving skin looking more luminous  Additionally, GF 15% Solution also supports skin hydration and strengthens the skin barrier after one application for a more healthy-looking appearance.  Skin naturally contains different types of growth factors, including EGF, IGF, and TGF. Growth factors for skin work to signal it’s natural repair mechanisms. Over time and with age, skin’s natural levels of growth factors declines, contributing to the appearance of visible signs of aging. GF 15% Solution contains a 15% solution of plant-based biomimetic EGF, TGF, and IGF peptides. These offer a triple-action approach for short, mid and long-term skin renewal benefits.  A complex of IGF helps to regenerate the appearance of skin by helping support skin density and minimise visible wrinkles.  An EGF complex helps to support skin’s natural elastin and process of skin renewal, to target the appearance of aging factors like wrinkles, while promoting elasticity and firmness.  A solution of TGF improves skin’s integrity by supporting natural collagen to minimize visible lines and wrinkles, while promoting skin firmness and elasticity and smoothing skin texture.  Testing shows: Instantly Healthier-looking Skin: Immediately improves the look of rough skin and enhances skin radiance Visible Wrinkle Repair: Visibly repairs wrinkles in 1 week*. Visible Skin Regeneration: Helps repair visible skin damage in 2 weeks. Firming and Lifting: Firms the face and neck in 4 weeks** and jawline looks more lifted**. Barrier Support: Skin is stronger, more resilient with one use.  *Clinical testing on 42 people, using the product 2x/day for 1 week. **Clinical testing on 42 people, using the product 2x/day for 4 weeks.

title: Retinol 0.5% in Squalane
full_name: The Ordinary Retinol 0.5% in Squalane
description_raw:
DescriptionSkin Type: Combination, Dry, Normal, OilySkincare By Age: 20s, 30s, 40s, 50+What it is:Highly-Stable, Water-Free Solution of 0.5% Pure Retinol
What it does:This water-free solution contains 0.5% pure Retinol, an ingredient that can reduce the appearances of fine lines, of photo damage and of general skin aging. While Retinol has been studied extensively, it is irritating to the skin and newer technologies exist that mimic the visible effects of Retinol without causing skin irritation. For this reason, we generally recommend using Granactive Retinoid 2% or Granactive Retinoid 5% instead of this formula. Caution: Retinol can cause significant irritation, redness and peeling, especially around the eyes and mouth, in the early stages of treatment while skin builds tolerance. If you have not used high-strength retinol formulas in the past, we strongly recommend that you start your retinol regimen with our Retinol 0.2% in Squalane and adjust to higher strengths of Retinol 0.5% in Squalane and Retinol 1% in Squalane as your skin builds tolerance. You will achieve the same end results without the unpleasant redness and peeling along the way.
Note: Water can affect the stability of retinol. Additionally, plant oils in retinol formulations can trigger lipid peroxidation and can impair retinol integrity. This formula does not contain water, silicones, plant oils or alcohol. Caution: Retinoids can make the skin more sensitive to UV radiation. Sun protection is particularly important when using retinoids. This product must not be used in conjunction with other retinoids including retinol or retinoic acid. This product is not a treatment for acne. Acne-prone skin may experience a temporary increase in acne during the first few weeks of using any form of retinoid including those used in this formulation.
Note: When pregnant or breastfeeding, it is recommended to avoid any skincare products containing retinoids such as formulations with Granactive Retinoid or Retinol.

title: Multi-Antixoidant Radiance Serum
full_name: The Ordinary Multi-Antixoidant Radiance Serum
description_raw:
DescriptionSkin Type: Combination, Dry, Normal, Oily, SensitiveSkin Concerns: Ageing, Dryness, Dullness, Fine Lines & Wrinkles, Firmness & Elasticity, Pigmentation & Dark Spots, Uneven Skin Texture, Uneven Skin ToneSkincare By Age: 20s, 30s, 40s, 50+, Under 20What it is:A daily antioxidant serum with 8 technologies that helps protect skin and boost radiance.
What it does:Multi-Antioxidant Radiance Serum is a daily serum combining a wide range of antioxidant and protective technologies to combat multiple concerns associated with environmental damage and visibly brighten dull skin.
Multi-Active Radiance Serum works to combat environmental stressors, like pollution and smog, which can make skin look dull and prematurely aged. The formulation boosts radiance, while helping to fade visible dark spots and smooth the look of skin texture, all of which help to reduce the appearance of atmospheric skin aging.
Multi-Antioxidant Radiance Serum combines a total of 8 technologies, including vitamin C and ginseng, and achieves a multi-faceted approach to antioxidant protection suited to use both in the day and at night. When used in the day, the serum-textured formulation helps shield against the damaging effects of pollution, while providing barrier strengthening and lasting hydrating for enhanced skin resilience.
When used at night, it continues to offer antioxidant protection while skin is in its resting and repair stages, working to boost radiance for skin that is visibly more radiant during the day.
Part of our range of Multi-Active Solutions, the eight key technologies found in Multi-Antioxidant Radiance Serum are:
Ascorbyl Glucoside: A stabilized form of vitamin C which is converted to its active form inside the skin.
Ginseng extract: A plant extract that helps protect and soothe skin’s stress response against environmental aggressors.
EGCG: Designed to help shield against environmental irritants, while protecting skin from external stressors that can contribute to signs of aging.
Acetyl Tetrapeptide-2: A protective biomimetic peptide which helps target the appearance of uneven skin tone to promote a more radiant, healthier-looking appearance.
Heptapeptide-6: A turmeric peptide that helps protect against environmental aggressors while also targeting common signs of aging.
Ergothioneine: An antioxidant found naturally within the skin, that helps provide protection against environmental stressors which can cause visible skin damage.
Tocotrienols: Derived from annatto seeds and a source of Vitamin E, these molecules help protect from the damaging effects of environmental pollution that can contribute to signs of atmospheric skin aging, while soothing signs of skin irritation that can be caused by environmental stressors.
Tremella Fuciformis Sporocarp extract: A polysaccharide (chain of sugar-like molecules) derived from snow fungus which create a protective film on skin’s surface, helping to attract and hold on to water like a moisture magnet.
Testing Shows:
Antioxidant protection: Protects from multiple kinds of environmental stressors.
Holistic environmental protection: Combats 5 key signs of environmental damage.
Radiance boosting: Boosts radiance for luminous-looking skin.
Evens skin tone appearance: Helps fade visible dark spots in 2 weeks*.
Soothes visible redness: Redness is visibly reduced by 45%**.
Skin texture is visibly smoothed: Immediately smooths the look of skin texture.
Skin is hydrated with a stronger barrier: Strengthens skin barrier to increase resilience against environmental stressors.
*Clinical testing on 44 people after using the product 2x/day for 2 weeks.
**Clinical testing on 44 people after using the product 2x/day for 4 weeks.
Disclaimer+ View Full Description

What it includes:* Key technology and Ingredients 
A concentrated extract of Japanese camellia from Gotoh Island, where camellias bloom vigorously, despite the harsh environment. The core of our key ingredient: Power Fermented Camellia+ Shiseido’s innovative Power Fermented Camellia+ contains Camellia seed extract, with antioxidant properties. Through a fusion of cutting-edge bio-fermentation technologies ki-koji inspired by Japanese traditional fermentation, Shiseido now amplifies the potential of amino acid for the skin, boosting the amino acids in camellia seeds by  3.4x*. *Compared to before fermentation Targeting the source of aging in the skin, this unique ingredient supports protecting the skin from aging factors such as dryness and boosts your skin’s inner strength to achieve its full beauty potential. With respect for nature and the ideal of less-waste production, almost every bit of the camellia plant *⁷ is utilised in new Ultimune. From petals to leaves to seeds, virtually almost every bit of the Gotoh Island camellia plant is utilised in making Ultimune. This reflects Shiseido’s focus on sustainability, and concern for the ecosystems of our sourcing locations.   
- Camellia Seed Extract : Made by upcycling the strained lees of the camellia seeds, to bring the full power of fermented camellia. Contains Camellia Seed Extract with anti-oxidant properties. 
- Camellia Leaf Extract: supports protecting the skin from stimulus of excess sebum due to dryness. 
- Camellia Flower Extract: supports the skin barrier by improving the stratum corneum’s resistance. 
- Camellia Seed Oil- supports moisture with an emollient effect.  
* Nature-conscious packaging: The materials, shapes and specifications of the new Ultimune packaging are centered on sustainability, interpreting its familiar form and essence in eco-conscious ways. 
- The container is made of more than 15% recycled glass. 
- The Ultimune serum line-up has a total 20% reduction in container weight (excluding 30ml and 120ml)  
- Refills reduce plastic waste by 93% vs the regular pack. 
- Refill cap is made of 50% plant-derived plastic. 
- The outer carton is made with FSC-certified paper from responsible wood sources.What else you need to know:Beyond strengthening skin’s barrier, Ultimune produced remarkable results in both clinical tests and consumer claims. Clinical tests prove that it slows the skin aging cycle by reducing aging factors*¹. And 98% felt that aging signs*² were visibly reduced in 4weeks*³. *¹The negative spiral leading to fine lines and wrinkles from dryness *² dryness and wrinkles. *³Consumer test result of 107 women. Clinically proven to improve these 11 aging signs: Uneven skin tone, redness, dullness, enlarged pores, roughness, wrinkles, smile lines, fine lines, lack of translucency, reduced firmness and loss of elasticity. Clinical findings based on both visual and instrumental assessments: 
- Skin’s aging cycle slowed as aging factors were reduced by over 11%*¹. 
- Roughness improved by 18%*², firmness by 27%*³ and radiance by 19% in 8 weeks*². *1 Clinical test of 32 women for 8 weeks use. full_name: The Ordinary Retinal 0.2% Emulsion
description_raw:
DescriptionSkin Type: Combination, Dry, Normal, OilySkin Concerns: Dullness, Pigmentation & Dark Spots, Uneven Skin Texture, Uneven Skin ToneSkincare By Age: 20s, 30s, 40s, 50+, Under 20What it is:A high-strength retinoid formula with stabilised retinaldehyde for advanced age support, optimised for nighttime use.
What it does:Retinal 0.2% Emulsion is a very high strength retinoid formula that rapidly firms and smooths skin, while noticeably reducing the appearance of dark spots. It helps refine skin texture, while targeting uneven tone and boosting luminosity for brighter, more even-looking skin.  The serum-textured formula is suitable for all skin types, and is recommended for experienced users of retinoids.
What it includes:
What else you need to know:* Free from Alcohol, Oil, Silicone, Gluten 
* Vegan  
* Cruelty-free 
* If you are new to using retinoids, we recommend exploring the Granactive Retinoid 2% Emulsion, or the Retinol 0.2% in Squalane, and progressing to higher strengths as your skin builds tolerance.   
* Retinal (also known as retinaldehyde) is a well-studied retinoid that offers more efficient delivery of the most direct form of vitamin A molecules than retinol, thanks to being 1 conversion step closer to the bioactive form of vitamin A.    
* With a high 0.2% concentration of retinal, Retinal 0.2% Emulsion is able to noticeably improve skin firmness and improve the look of lines and wrinkles, including crow’s feet, frown lines, and forehead wrinkles.   
* Retinal 0.2% Emulsion also contains synthetic oat analogues (specifically avenanthramide - a key beneficial component found in oats). This ingredient is known to help target skin discomfort and dryness, which are common concerns associated with retinoid use.  The bright yellow hue of the formula comes from the high concentration of retinal, which is naturally yellow. This may leave some residual colour on skin and light coloured fabrics, which can be minimised by allowing the product to fully absorb, and skin to dry before making contact with light-coloured fabrics. This residual colour can be removed by washing skin with water, and washing fabrics with your regular detergent according to their care instructions. Disclaimer+ View Full Description

full_name: Drunk Elephant Amino Rain Glasswater Serum
description_raw:
DescriptionSkin Type: Combination, Dry, Normal, OilySkin Concerns: Uneven Skin Texture, RednessFormulation: SerumSkincare By Age: Under 20What it is:An advanced hydration serum that awakens skin with an instant pop of opalescence, boosts luminosity over time, and firms and soothes skin for a glass-like finish.
What it does:Formulated with a unique duo of 1% fermented poly amino acid (aka polyglutamic acid) and 0.5% dipalmitoyl hydroxyproline, Amino Rain delivers powerful, long-lasting hydration while supporting healthy collagen. Its Hiya Super Hydration Water Complex helps improve skin’s water-recovery, improving elasticity and barrier function, while a light-boosting system supercharges your complexion with radiance for a glass-like appearance. Skin feels soothed and hydrated and looks more luminous instantly and over time.
What else you need to know:WHAT ELSE YOU NEED TO KNOWHealthy skin requires a balance of hydration and moisture. Hydration refers to the water content in the surface layers of the skin. Without proper hydration, skin becomes tight, brittle, and rough, leading to a compromised barrier and a buildup of dead skin cells.   Moisture, on the other hand, is about the essential lipids and oils (such as ceramides and cholesterol) that protect the skin’s barrier and its ability to retain hydration. Lack of moisture can lead to chronically red, flaky, and uncomfortable skin.   In other words, dry skin lacks oil (moisture), and dehydrated skin lacks water (hydration). Amino Rain's sophisticated formulation helps maintain the critical balance of water in skin and can be mixed with any Drunk Elephant cream or oil (like Lala Retro) for the essential moisture that skin needs.  Amino Rain is formulated at a skin-friendly pH of 5.5 and 100% free of essential oils, silicones, fragrance/dyes, and solvent alcohols.

ingredients_raw: 1.0% fermented poly amino acid: Aka polyglutamic acid. Created through the polymerization—linking—of molecules of glutamic acid (an amino acid). Saccharide isomerate: A complex blend of plant-derived sugars with hydration-boosting properties for skin. Virgin marula oil: This super-absorbable oil, high in critical antioxidants and omegas 6 and 9, is known to help moisturize, nourish, and rejuvenate skin for a youthful glow.

An exceptionally high concentration of the skin's most hydrophilic and naturally available humectant, it is fast-absorbing and induces instant suppleness.
What it does:A pure and clean formula with virtually no additives to offer maximum functionality of ingredients to the skin. An exceptionally high concentra- tion of the skin’s most hydrophilic and naturally available humectant, this pure hydro-boosting serum nurtures skin by way of deep hydration, fortification, and calming of sensitivity. Combined with Bamboo Extract – an ingredient rich in silica deposits that function as the “glue” to bond skin proteins together, this serum bolsters up skin immunity and resilience against sensitizing agents.
What it includes:Formulated with Bamboo Extract 
- an ingredient rich in silica deposits that function as the "glue" to bond skin proteins, this serum bolsters up skin immunity while providing below-the-surface hydration. What else you need to know:Hailed and hyped as the “it” ingredient for skin hydration, Hyaluronic Acid has stood the test of time and proven itself to be a staple ingredient of skin care serums. 

It is interesting to note that Sodium Hyaluronate, the solute form of HA, is available in various molecular weights, with larger molecules forming a breathable film on skin surface to bind moisture in the environment, while smaller molecules can penetrate a bit deeper into skin to provide below-the-surface hydration as well as reducing the appearance of wrinkles and fine lines.

title: 100% L-Ascorbic Acid Powder
full_name: The Ordinary 100% L-Ascorbic Acid Powder
description_raw:
DescriptionSkin Type: Combination, Dry, Normal, Oily, SensitiveSkin Concerns: Ageing, Dullness, Fine Lines & Wrinkles, Uneven Skin ToneSkincare By Age: 20s, 30s, 40s, 50+, Under 20What it is:Fine 325 Mesh Topical Powder
What it does:Vitamin C is an effective antioxidant that brightens the skin tone and reduces the appearance of signs of aging. This formula offers a very fine L-Ascorbic Acid powder that visibly targets the appearance of uneven skin tone, dullness, and signs of aging and is formulated to be mixed with other treatments (except those containing Niacinamide or EUK 134).
The format of this formula is a very fine, anhydrous, L-Ascorbic Acid powder and, as such, provides the most direct exposure of extremely high concentrations of Vitamin C topically. With such format, a very strong tingling but non-irritating sensation is expected during the first 1-2 weeks of use until the skin's tolerance to such high exposure is elevated.

If topical Vitamin C is used as part of skincare, it should be applied at alternate times with EUK 134 or Niacinamide (ideally Vitamin C in the PM and EUK 134/Niacinamide in the AM). Otherwise, EUK 134/Niacinamide can affect the integrity of pure-form Vitamin C (L-Ascorbic Acid). Topical Vitamin C offers a wide array of benefits to the skin. However, many forms of Vitamin C and many more formulations of Vitamin C are available commercially with a potential to confuse the audience. We have developed a guide that offers guidance on the formulations of Vitamin C offered under The Ordinary range. It also offers education on Vitamin C itself and on the differences between formulations of Vitamin C at large. Please click here for this guide.

description_raw:
DescriptionFunction: ColourSkin Type: Combination, Dry, Normal, OilySkin Concerns: DrynessSkincare By Age: 20s, 30s, 40s, 50+, Under 20Benefits: Long-wearingWhat it is:A multi-benefit brow serum that noticeably improves texture and manageability and encourages the appearance of fuller-looking brows.
What it does:Brow Genius® blends 6 rejuvenating ingredients into a multi-benefit, brilliant formula that is designed to create smoother, softer, tamer, fuller-looking brows that feel and perform like the brows you have always wanted. Think a smoother, softer, tamer, fuller-looking brow that feels and performs like the brows you have always wanted. From peptides, panthenol and Korean ginseng to biotin and castor oil, this power roster of ingredients is designed to nourish brows, increase manageability and deliver the ultimate brow makeover. Panthenol helps to smooth, soften and tame coarse or wiry texture for easier styling and manageability. Biotin helps to coat the hair to create fuller looking strands and Castor Oil helps to protect, nourish and condition brow hair and create a healthy environment on skin.

What it does:A glass of water for skin 
Formulated with 97% ingredients from natural origin, this serum contains a powerful duo of active ingredients: 2% polyglutamic and hyaluronic acids, which are known to hydrate skin. 

Boost your skin’s hydration levels with this serum 
Instantly, the skin looks more hydrated as if plumped up with water. Not only that, the serum's non-greasy texture is absorbed quickly and the skin remains intensely hydrated for 24 hours (1). Once applied, the skin feels plumper and the appearance of wrinkles, fine lines, and signs of fatigue is reduced. 

Super ingredients known for their efficacy: 
The hydrating serum is formulated with a cocktail of active ingredients known to hydrate skin. Our formula contains hyaluronic acid, the star ingredient derived from wheat, as well as polyglutamic acid, derived from corn and soy. 

A serum formulated based on strict criteria: 
The hydrating serum is formulated with 97% ingredients from natural origin and is clinically proven to be suitable for all skin types. We have also chosen to focus on efficacy and star ingredients, which is why the formula is unscented. 

What else you need to know:Our hydrating serum is developed with a more responsible way 
The bottle is made of 40% recycled glass. On top of that, our cardboard comes from sustainably managed forests and the labels are printed with ink from vegetable origin.

title: Mandelic Pigmentation Corrector Night Serum
full_name: Allies of Skin Mandelic Pigmentation Corrector Night Serum
description_raw:
DescriptionSkin Type: Combination, Dry, Normal, Oily, SensitiveSkin Concerns: Breakouts / Blemishes, Blackheads, Dullness, Pigmentation & Dark Spots, Uneven Skin Texture, Uneven Skin Tone, PoresSkincare By Age: 20s, 30s, 40s, 50+, Under 20What it is:A multi-award-winning overnight serum supercharged with a blend of 11% Mandelic, Lactic & Salicylic Acid, 1% Bakuchiol, 8 Brighteners, 7 Antioxidants and Peptides that reduces the appearance of stubborn dullness and discolouration for brighter, even-toned skin.
What it does:While most AHA (Alpha-Hydroxy Acids) serums focus only on the exfoliation aspect that can sometimes lead to tightness and irritation, this multitasking serum is formulated to not only gently dissolve dead skin cells but also replenish moisture and nourish the skin with its hydrating blend of Hyaluronic Acid, Niacinamide and essential fatty acids from Organic Rosehip and Tamanu Oils. Bakuchiol provides Retinol-like benefits clinically proven to reduce multiple signs of ageing, significantly reduces roughness and helps to improve skin tone, elasticity, firmness and radiance, while multiple peptides like Acetyl Tetrapeptide-40 and Nonapeptide-1 offset redness and promote radiance. full_name: Sephora Collection Targeted Dark Spots - Serum
description_raw:
DescriptionSkin Type: Combination, Dry, Normal, Oily, SensitiveSkin Concerns: Dullness, Pigmentation & Dark Spots, Uneven Skin ToneSkincare By Age: 20s, 30s, 40s, 50+, Under 20What it is:A serum containing 3% enzymes and kombucha, to visibly reduce the appearance of pigmentation spots.
What it does:A serum that targets darks spots on your skin
Age or external factors such as sun, UV rays and stress, can cause dark spots to appear on the skin. To reduce their appearance, using a targeted dark spots serum every day is essential.
Made with 93% ingredients from natural origin , SEPHORA COLLECTION’s unscented targeted dark spots serum contains 3% enzymes and kombucha and reduces the appearance of pigmentation spots. From the very first application, complexion is brighter and more even. After 28 days of use, there are fewer pigmentation spots and they are smaller and less visible. Its lightweight texture is quickly absorbed and does not leave an oily film on the skin.
What else you need to know:A targeted dark spots serum containing super ingredients for a visible and measurable efficacy on dark spots
It combines a 3% concentration of two ingredients from natural origin:
Kombucha extracted from black tea fermentation, to brighten and even out the skin tone.
Enzymes extracted from papaya, to exfoliate skin.

A targeted dark spots serum following a strict formulation charter
Our targeted dark spot serum contains 93% ingredients from natural origin and is clinically proven for all skin types; it does not contain any ingredient from animal origin. We chose to concentrate on effectiveness and star ingredients, which is why our serum is unscented.

Packaging developed with a responsible approach
The bottle of this targeted dark spots serum is made with 40% recycled glass. This cardboard comes from sustainably managed forests and printed with inks from vegetable origin. The bottle and cardboard are recyclable (check locally).

100% found dark spots less intense*

95% found fewer dark spots*

title: Multi Hyaluronic Antioxidant Hydration Serum
full_name: Allies of Skin Multi Hyaluronic Antioxidant Hydration Serum
description_raw:
DescriptionSkin Type: Combination, Dry, Normal, OilySkin Concerns: Ageing, Dryness, Fine Lines & WrinklesSkincare By Age: 20s, 30s, 40s, 50+What it is:
Inject skin with concentrated hydration + antioxidants. * This skin-restoring serum is supercharged with multiple forms of Hyaluronic Acid (Low Molecular Weight, High Molecular Weight, and Botanical Polysaccharide), 5% Resveratrol Ferment Complex, 2% Superoxide Dismutase, and 8 Antioxidants & Peptides to intensely hydrate, plump, and repair dehydrated skin. Formulated for all skin types.

What it does:Instantly: 

Provides a mega dose of hydration. 
Soothes skin and reduces fatigue. 
Trains skin to retain moisture better while strengthening the skin barrier. 
Over time: 
Reduces the appearance of fine lines by plumping the skin. 
Repairs dehydrated skin. 
Promotes rejuvenation and improves skin elasticity.  
Helps to protect the moisturising capacity of the skin.

What it includes:Hyaluronic Acid, 5% Resveratrol Ferment Complex, 2% Superoxide Dismutase, 8 Antioxidants & PeptidesWhat else you need to know:* We use multiple forms of Hyaluronic Acid (Low Molecular Weight, High Molecular Weight, and Botanical Polysaccharide) to infuse the skin with concentrated moisture and plump up the appearance of fine lines. Besides hydrating, this formula trains the skin to retain moisture better while strengthening the skin barrier with Niacinamide and Phospholipids. 
* An optimal concentration of powerful antioxidants, 5% Resveratrol Ferment and 2% Superoxide Dismutase offers a dramatic reduction in signs of fatigue, reduces free radical damage, promotes firming, and supports a healthy barrier function. 
* Palmitoyl Tripeptide-38 promotes rejuvenation and improves skin elasticity. At the same time, Strawberry Fruit Extract prevents anti-hyaluronidase activity (a process where enzymes in the skin break down natural Hyaluronic Acid), thus helping to protect the moisturising capacity of the skin. 
* This serum goes beyond simply moisturising the skin — it infuses it with concentrated moisture and prevents the breakdown of natural Hyaluronic Acid. Over time, skin is trained to retain moisture better all day long. 
* Recommended for: All skin types — especially dehydrated and tired with loss of volume. 
p* H: 4.2 - 5.3

title: The Serum
full_name: Augustinus Bader The Serum
description_raw:
DescriptionSkin Type: Combination, Dry, Normal, OilySkin Concerns: Ageing, Dryness, Dullness, Fine Lines & Wrinkles, Firmness & ElasticitySkincare By Age: 20s, 30s, 40s, 50+What it is:Inspired by over 30 years of scientific innovation, The Serum is an intensely hydrating, fast-absorbing concentrate formulated to zero in on skin’s most persistent challenges, from dehydration to visible signs of aging to environmental damage, and resolve frequent complexion concerns, for optimal health and radiance. Powered by TFC8® - our proprietary blend of amino acids, high-grade vitamins and synthesized molecules that provide key nutrients to the skin and support the body’s innate renewal processes - and carefully designed to be combined with our face moisturizers for unprecedented results and an unmistakable Bader glow.
What it does:
Provides intense hydration to the skin
Offers antioxidant and free-radical protection while visibly reducing the signs of aging caused by environmental influences
Reduces appearance of fine lines and wrinkles
Boosts skin’s natural radiance
Absorbs quickly
Carefully designed to be combined with our face moisturizers

What it includes:作為新時代的日常必需品，藍鑽全能精華的配方結合 TFC8®技術與純淨植物保濕成分，包括活力維生素 C、具高效抗氧化力的石榴籽萃取及白藜蘆醇（可抵禦污染物），以及雪絨花提取物，讓躁動不穩的膚況，暗沉無光的膚色再度重生，持續散發健康膨潤光澤。What else you need to know:藍鑽全能精華經過精心研製，完美配合我們的皇牌面霜 AB 藍面霜和 AB 藍乳霜，成為 Augustinus Bader 日常護膚方案中必要的修復程序，憑藉卓效、高滲透並無添加的安全修護配方，助肌膚抵禦時光流逝，煥發金色年輕光采。因應顧客的需求而產生，藍鑽全能精華以科學為基礎，透過注入 TFC8®技術為肌膚提供智慧解決方
案，可單獨使用或作為其他配方的補充品。

藍鑽全能精華代表護膚界的未來，融合臨床創新與可持續發展的世界願景。極簡俐落的奢華玫瑰金管身盛裝在璀璨的藍色玻璃容器，用上可輕易拆除的補充裝設計，每件組件都可被回收再造，務求最大限度地減少廢物並保護地球的寶貴資源；玻璃容器亦可作為優雅的花瓶，或用作盛載化妝掃、筆或其他用品，為日常生活帶來樂趣與美感。

description_raw:
DescriptionSkin Type: Combination, Dry, Normal, OilySkin Concerns: Oiliness, PoresSkincare By Age: 20s, 30s, 40s, 50+, Under 20What it is:A serum containing 6% BHA and PHA for tightened pores and a mattified, visibly less oily skin.
What it does:With 6% BHA & PHA, this targeted pores serum delivers targeted efficacy
The SEPHORA COLLECTION targeted pores serum with 6% BHA (salicylic acid) and PHA is your new go-to serum for mattified skin, tightened pores and a visibly less oily skin. From the very first application, skin is smoothed and mattified. After 28 days’ application of our Pores Serum with BHA and PHA, pores are visibly reduced and tightened, and skin texture is smoother. The formula is quickly absorbed and makes a formidable ally when it comes to improving the appearance of pores before applying a moisturizing cream.
What else you need to know:A targeted pores serum containing super ingredients for a formula that is efficient on dilated pores
With 96% ingredients from natural origin, it contains a mixture of 6% BHA (salicylic acid) and PHA:
Our salicylic acid (BHA) from natural origin is extracted from gaultheria tree, known for its purifying properties.
Our PHA from natural origin is extracted from corn and is an acid known for its exfoliating properties.

A targeted pores serum following a strict formulation charter
Our targeted pores serum contains 96% ingredients from natural origin and is clinically proven for all skin types; it does not contain any ingredient from animal origin. We chose to concentrate on effectiveness and star ingredients, which is why our serum is unscented.

Packaging developed with a responsible approach
The bottle containing this targeted pores serum is made with 40% recycled glass. The cardboard comes from sustainably managed forests and is printed with inks from vegetable origin. The bottle and cardboard are recyclable (check locally).

Efficacy
95% found their skin mattified after 1st application*
85% found pores clearer**
90% found their skin clearer**
*% of women satisfied after 1st application. In use test on 22 volunteers.
**% of women satisfied after 28 days of use. In use test on 20 volunteers

Purifies pores and targets blemishes at the root, for clear, smooth, even skin. Helps optimize the skin microbiome and prevent the growth of bacteria responsible for skin concerns. Helps reduce the appearance of acne scars and hyperpigmentation. Locks in moisture, to keep skin hydrated, radiant, and plump.

Natural origin salicylic acid extracted from gaultheria leaves, known to purify the skin.

title: Advanced Night Repair Eye Concentrate Matrix Synchronized Multi-Recovery Complex
full_name: Estée Lauder Advanced Night Repair Eye Concentrate Matrix Synchronized Multi-Recovery Complex
description_raw:
DescriptionFunction: Moisturise, TreatmentSkin Type: Combination, Dry, Normal, OilySkin Concerns: Ageing, Dark Circles, Fine Lines & Wrinkles, Firmness & Elasticity, PuffinessFormulation: LiquidSkincare By Age: 20s, 30s, 40s, 50+What it is:An eye serum to let your eyes express the beauty of you.
What it does:
This ultra-nourishing eye concentrate reduces the look of lines in every eye zone, and targets multiple eye area concerns: crow’s feet lines, “11” lines between brows, under-eye lines, wrinkles, loss of firmness, puffy eyes and dark circles.
Eyes bounce back—look more youthful, vibrant, healthy.
Chronolux™ Power Signal Technology helps increase the skin’s natural ability for visible repair, with in-vitro testing showing it promotes skin’s natural renewal of fresh new cells and boosts its natural production of collagen.
With continued use of the formula, lines and wrinkles look reduced. 360° Mesh Matrix “Shock Absorber” is a fortifying blend of Visco-Elastic Polymer and multi-molecular weight Hyaluronic Acids. It cushions thin, delicate eye skin to counter visible effects of dynamic expressions like blinking, squinting and smiling. That’s key because these constant eye micromovements—in addition to the stresses of today’s non-stop screentime and staying awake longer—impacts collagen, contributing to lines, wrinkles and other signs of ageing.
The Cooling Cryo-Steel Wand is a custom-designed applicator, crafted from stainless steel, cools puffy eyes on contact. Its precision contour tip has a high-polish surface that massages and glides without tugging—vital for thin, fragile eye skin. It provides long-lasting cooling for up to 5 minutes. Using the wand plus the Eye Matrix reduces the look of undereye puffiness instantly.

What else you need to know:* Recyclable glass bottle and carton.
* Reusable cryo-steel wand.
* Dermatologist-tested.
* Ophthalmologist-tested.
* Non-acnegenic.
* Free of synthetic fragrance.
* Free of parabens, phthalates, sulfates and mineral oil.
* Ideal for all ages, all ethnicities, all skintypes. 
* This next-generation Multi-Recovery formula has the same beloved cushioning, nourishing texture as it had before.  Disclaimer+ View Full Description

description_raw:

What it does:
Reduces eye puffiness and eliminates dark circles
Increases skin firmness around the eye area
Reduces appearances of fine lines and wrinkles
Boosts radiance giving the appearance of looking more awake

What it includes:以品牌獨家專利科技 TFC8®、天然氨基酸、高質維生素和肌膚所需各種營養物質組成天然複合物，增強肌膚細胞自我修護、賦能煥新的過程 — 結合非凡純淨植物配方：法國海藻、積雪草及三果木樹皮萃取 — 將抗老修復功效精準定位，帶來更新煥活效果；菸鹼醯胺及維生素 C — 高效的抗氧化成分，幫助逆轉肌齡，減少細紋和皺紋的形成，同時抵禦環境中藍光、陽光造成的傷害。
What else you need to know:藍鑽全能眼霜經過精心研製，完美配合皇牌的 AB 藍面霜和 AB 藍乳霜，成為 Augustinus Bader 日常護膚方案中必要的修復程序，憑藉卓效、高滲透並無添加的安全修護配方，助肌膚抵禦時光流逝，煥發金色年輕光采。因應顧客的需求而產生，藍鑽全能眼霜以科學為基礎，透過注入 TFC8®技術為肌膚提供智慧解決方案，可單獨使用或作為其他配方的補充品。

藍鑽全能眼霜代表護膚界的未來，融合臨床創新與可持續發展的世界願景。極簡俐落的奢華玫瑰金管身盛裝在璀璨的藍色陶瓷容器中，用上可輕易拆除的補充裝設計，每件組件都可被回收再造，務求最大限度地減少廢物並保護地球的寶貴資源；陶瓷容器亦可作為優雅的花瓶，或用作盛載化妝掃、筆或其他用品，為日常生活帶來樂趣與美感。"

ingredients_raw: 3% Ceramide Blend: Plant-derived ceramides AP, NP, and EOP are identical to the wax-like moisturizing ceramides that occur naturally in skin. Chia Seed Oil: Soothing, moisturizing plant oil that is naturally rich in omega fatty acids, antioxidant carotenoids, and phenolic compounds. Flax Seed Oil: Naturally rich in omega-3 fatty acids, flax seed oil is both soothing and moisturizing to skin. Avocado Oil: Oil extracted from the kernel of the avocado. Its high content of plant sterols makes it a powerful softener for dry, deprived skin. Jojoba Seed Oil: A natural source of vitamins A and E, this ingredient is chemically similar to the sebum found in skin, which is why it is often used for its soothing and moisturizing benefits. Marula Butter: A super-pure, concentrated, deeply moisturizing butter derived from marula oil and rich in antioxidant polyphenols, lipids, and fatty acids. Virgin Marula Oil: This super-absorbable oil, high in critical antioxidants and omegas 6 and 9, helps moisturize, nourish, and rejuvenate skin for a youthful glow. description_raw:
DescriptionFunction: Moisturise, TreatmentSkin Type: Combination, Dry, Normal, OilySkin Concerns: Dark Circles, Dryness, PuffinessFormulation: CreamSkincare By Age: 20s, 30s, 40s, 50+, Under 20What it is:Made with 96% ingredients from natural origin, this unscented eye cream is your best ally for brighter, wide-awake eyes all day long.
What it does:An eye contour cream that visibly reduces eye fatigue 
Fighting dark circles, under-eye bags and signs of aging is daily work. Made with 96% ingredients from natural origin, this unscented eye contour cream is your best ally for brighter, wide-awake eyes all day long. Its top benefit? Retains water in skin and protects it from dehydration. With 96% ingredients from natural origin, it divides dark circles by 2 in just 1 month(1). 

Take care of your eye contour area with super ingredients 
This anti dark circles cream has ingredients known for their ability to wake up tired eyes and boost radiance:
 - hyaluronic acid from natural origin, extracted from wheat. 
 - caffeine from natural origin, known for its depuffing effect. 

An eye contour cream that follows a strict formulation charter 
Our eye contour cream is made with 96% ingredients from natural origin and is clinically proven for all skin types. On top of that, our eye contour product doesn’t contain any animal-derived ingredient. We chose to concentrate on efficacy and star ingredients, this is why our eye contour cream is unscented. 

An eye contour cream developed with responsible approach
Our eye contour cream jar is made with 72% recycled plastic. Cardboard comes from sustainably managed forests and printed with plant-based inks.

(1) Scientific test performed on 21 volunteers after 28 days of use.
What else you need to know:Measured efficacy 

	-51% color of dark circles (1) 
	-56% size of dark circles (1) 
	+29% depuffing effect (1) 
	+61% radiance after 28 days (1) 
	+48% hydration after 4 hrs (2) 
 
(1) Scientific test performed on 21 volunteers after 28 days of use. 
(2) Scientific measurement performed on 10 volunteers, 4 hours after application.

The delicate eye area is nourished and hydrated. 
Skin feels soft and looks less puffy.

Neodermyl helps improve firmness by 13x after 15 days.^
Helps to brighten appearance of the under-eye area by 19% after 56 days.^^

* ^According to Orchistem™ in vivo efficacy test results of 56 days with 26 participants. 
* ^^According to Bioskinup™ Contour 3R in vivo efficacy test results of 4 weeks with 21 participants. 
* Recommended for: All skin types - especially fatigued, dull and those concerned with premature ageing. 
* pH: 4.7 - 5.7

DescriptionFunction: Moisturise, TreatmentSkin Concerns: Dryness, Dullness, Fine Lines & Wrinkles, Firmness & Elasticity, Uneven Skin TextureFinish: NaturalFormulation: Balm, CreamSkincare By Age: 20s, 30s, 40s, 50+, Under 20Benefits: HydratingWhat it is:An intensely hydrating lip treatment infused with jojoba oil and the rejuvenating power of collagen, keeping your lips soft and glowing.
What it does:This lip treatment is infused with jojoba oil, vegan collagen, and Korean rice to deeply hydrate and condition your lips. It helps reduce the appearance of fine lines while enhancing softness. Clinically tested to provide up to 72 hours of long-lasting moisture, it leaves lips feeling smooth and nourished.

• Vegan Collagen: Plumps, nourishes and visibly softens lips
